messages:
carla (product): Heads-up: we're standardizing code examples across docs to prefer structured output contracts (JSON/schema) instead of freeform text in the SDK samples. Goal: reduce downstream parsing bugs and make evals/replays reproducible. Please review the approach and call out any blockers. :sparkles:

ethan (eng): Agree with the move. A couple of asks: 1) include minimal migration examples for common patterns, 2) keep one freeform example per page for demos.

priya (docs): Plan: replace 1-line examples that show raw text with a compact structured example and a short note `// structured output recommended`.
Example before:
```python
resp = client.generate("Write a short bio")
print(resp.text)
```
After:
```python
resp = client.generate("Write a short bio", output_format="json")
print(resp.json())  # {"name":"...","summary":"..."}
```
I'll land a doc-lint rule to flag plain .text in examples except in demo pages.

lucas (support): Will prepare two canned replies: one that points customers at the structured-output guide, another that explains how to keep backward compat if they rely on plain text.

ethan (eng): SDK change: add an `output_format` kwarg that defaults to `text` for now, but we'll add a deprecation note to the README and suggest `json` for new examples. No breaking change. Need to coordinate timing with docs so examples don't mismatch.

carla (product): Timeline: docs PRs to start rolling tomorrow, lint rule in non-blocking mode for 2 weeks, then enforcement. SDK will ship the `output_format` flag in next minor release (2 weeks). We'll post a short all-eng note when the docs roll goes live.

audit-bot: Created RFC link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/structured-output-examples (internal).

priya (docs): Action items:
- update examples across quickstarts and SDK guides (owner: priya) — 10 business days
- add doc-lint rule and template PRs for samples repo (owner: priya & ci-team) — 3 days
- support canned replies (owner: lucas) — 2 days
- engineering: add `output_format` flag and short README note (owner: ethan) — 10 days

carla (product): Thanks all. If there are any compliance or accessibility concerns about the schema choices, flag them here. We'll keep a single canonical schema per feature and document it in the API reference. :white_check_mark:
